text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes. I've sent you the list in this DM:

- **#PD-4492**: from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting text messages telling them which bay to use. Support fixed it that evening, and Thea confirmed the 5 Oct early shift got through the gate fine.
- **#4419**: from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was passed to the second-level support team to test the scanner software. This note has no date.

A few things to watch for in the weekly notes:
- Moss's other two North notes (14 Sep 2025 and 23 Mar 2026) mention QFL but give no ticket numbers.
- Tickets #4409 and #4412 in the Central handoffs note belong to Marrow, not QFL.
- Quarendon Freightways, spelled with one "r", is a different company and not a customer.

I only looked at Moss's notes in the shared files and the channels you're in.
